name: Deadbolt II Cannon
description:
Manufacturer: Esperia
Item Type: Ballistic Cannon 
Size: 2

Spread dread with the Deadbolt II ballistic cannon. Feared for its firepower at short range, this notorious Tevarin weapon earned its intimidating reputation during the First Tevarin War as part of the Tevarin fleet's devastating arsenal. Esperia has painstakingly recreated the Deadbolt II out of respect to the original weapon and warriors who used it so effectively.
